data.title: King Faisal University Places 88th in 2027 Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings
data.content:
Al-Ahsa, November 21, 2026, SPA -- King Faisal University placed 88th globally and fourth among Saudi universities in the 2027 Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings, up from 99th in the previous edition, reflecting its progress in research performance and growing scientific collaboration across disciplines.
    The 2027 ranking includes 1,058 universities and higher education institutions worldwide and is issued by Times Higher Education in association with Schmidt Science Fellows. This result reflects the university's efforts to strengthen its research competitiveness and promote interdisciplinary work, while reinforcing its identity in food security and environmental sustainability.
    -- SPA
